name: ap-analytics
description: AP Analytics — AI-Powered Business Location Intelligence Platform

scripts.dev: node setup.mjs && concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node setup.mjs && npm run dev --prefix backend
scripts.dev:frontend: node setup.mjs && npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
